issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing partition keys or rate limiting scenarios.
The skill file contains extensive explanatory text and comments that add verbosity beyond the essential steps.
The instructions rely on bash commands and Azure CLI, which may not be available or behave differently on non-Unix platforms.
